core_claims.claim: AI/datacenter demand is driving near-term revenue acceleration, but durability depends on unverified order conversion.
core_claims.why_core: Directly determines whether recent growth is cyclical surge or structural shift.
core_claims.strongest_support: Management explicitly cites AI infrastructure demand in Q4 FY2026 results.
core_claims.strongest_counter: No backlog, hyperscaler mix, or volume-versus-pricing detail provided.
core_claims.missing_evidence: Order backlog, customer concentration, unit versus ASP trends.
core_claims.what_would_change_this_claim: Evidence of order cancellations, pricing erosion, or reliance on one hyperscaler.

core_claims.claim: Cloud & Networking mix shift is central to both growth durability and margin trajectory.
core_claims.why_core: Mix determines revenue quality and whether growth improves or dilutes profitability.
core_claims.strongest_support: Q3 and Q4 FY2026 releases show sequential revenue scale-up.
core_claims.strongest_counter: Segment growth rates and margins are not disclosed in provided evidence.
core_claims.missing_evidence: Segment-level revenue, margin, and customer concentration.
core_claims.what_would_change_this_claim: Disclosure that growth is concentrated in lower-margin products or few buyers.

core_claims.claim: Gross margin execution is the key lever converting AI volume into operating leverage.
core_claims.why_core: Determines whether demand acceleration produces earnings growth or dilutive expansion.
core_claims.strongest_support: Q3 FY2026 release references gross margin alongside higher revenue.
core_claims.strongest_counter: No product-line margin, pricing, or yield drivers disclosed.
core_claims.missing_evidence: Margin bridge by product, yield trends, pricing dynamics.
core_claims.what_would_change_this_claim: Evidence that mix shift or competition compresses margins despite higher volume.
